Working list of pages that need editorial attention. This is a manually maintained starting point — {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Pages Needing Review}} pages carry the {{tl|Article status}} tracking category automatically once tagged; this page is for human notes that don't fit neatly into that.

== Engineering section — populated (2026-08-07) ==
All 25 Ship Engineers and 13 Odyssey Engineers now have real, sourced content (locations, unlock requirements, specialties — see each page's own Sources section), not structural placeholders. Depth varies: [[Broo Tarquin]], [[Felicity Farseer]], [[Liz Ryder]], and [[Hera Tani]] got full research passes and are the quality-gate examples; the rest are researched at an "achievable depth" with single-sourced items explicitly flagged inline. All carry <code>status=Needs review</code> — none should be moved to ''Verified'' without a named reviewer checking claims directly against the live game, per [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Verification Policy]].

== Content architecture phase — demonstration content (2026-08-07) ==
Structural backbone (categories, templates, JSON/Lua data pipeline, topic hubs, redirects, editor docs) built this pass. The following are proof-of-concept pages, deliberately small and marked Draft, not yet complete:
* [[List of Engineers]], [[Engineer Capability Comparison]] — structured-data proof of concept, only 4 of 38 Engineers backed by a JSON record so far.
* [[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]] — the only guide built so far demonstrating the encyclopedia/guide split.
* [[Thargoid War History]] — Galactic Archive structural placeholder, no researched history yet.
* [[Trailblazers]] — Game Update proof of concept; date/version corroborated by two sources but Frontier's own update-notes page couldn't be fetched directly to confirm the exact client version string.
* [[Exploration]], [[Exobiology]], [[Combat]], [[Trade]], [[Mining]], [[Background Simulation]], [[Fleet Carriers]], [[Guardian]], [[Thargoid]] — new topic hub stubs, no individual articles yet.

== Pages with real content, not yet human-reviewed ==
* [[Tools and Resources]] — populated with a categorised list of established third-party community tools/sites; needs a named reviewer to confirm current URLs and that nothing has shut down or been superseded before it carries a ''Verified'' status. The new EDEngineer entry (2026-08-07) hasn't been independently checked beyond its GitHub page being live.
* All 38 Engineer pages (see above) — need a named reviewer with in-game access, not desk research, before ''Verified'' is appropriate.

== Open project decisions ==
* Structured-data approach: '''resolved''' this pass — Scribunto/Lua + JSON content-model pages, no new extension. Cargo was considered and explicitly deferred; revisit only if list/comparison generation genuinely outgrows this.
* Namespaces: '''resolved''' this pass — no new namespaces added; guides and archive content stay flat-titled in Main namespace, matching the existing site convention.
* 18 of 19 requested infobox wrapper types (Ship, Module, Weapon, Material, Commodity, Power, Faction, Station type, Settlement type, Colonisation facility, Equipment, Guardian technology, Thargoid entity, Location, Character, Organization, Event) are not yet built — only {{tl|Engineer infobox}} and {{tl|Game update infobox}} exist. Build each on-demand, the first time that entity family gets a real content pass.
* Whether/when to enable public registration — see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Contributing]].
* Whether/when to enable SVG uploads — see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Screenshot Policy]].
* Whether/when to lift the sysop-only upload restriction — uploads themselves are technically enabled (PNG/JPEG/WebP, 30MB), just not yet available to non-admin accounts.
